{{Quote|You must be the pretender Freedon Nadd warned me about!|Aleema Keto to Exar Kun, as Kun entered the Iron Citadel|audio=AleemaPretender.flac|<ref name="DLOTSA" />}}
A '''duel''' occurred late in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3997 BBY]] between two [[Dark Jedi/Legends|fallen Jedi]]: the power-thirsty [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]] and the headstrong [[Ulic Qel-Droma/Legends|Ulic Qel-Droma]]. The duel took place in the [[Empress Teta/Legends|Tetan]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Cinnagar/Legends|Cinnagar]], in the [[Iron Citadel/Legends|Iron Citadel]] of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] [[Krath/Legends|Krath]] [[Sith cult/Legends|cult]]. Qel-Droma, who had just [[Duel in the Iron Citadel (Satal Keto)|recently engaged]] and [[Death/Legends|killed]] the Krath leader [[Satal Keto/Legends|Satal Keto]], was given an ancient [[Sith talisman/Legends|Sith amulet]] by Satal's cousin, [[Aleema Keto|Aleema]], and was also taken as Aleema's joint partner in leadership of the Krath. Unbeknownst to them, a Dark [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] named Exar Kun had learned of their existence from the [[Force ghost/Legends|spirit]] of [[Freedon Nadd]], an ancient [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]], who had also given Kun an amulet for himself. Seeing the Krath as a potential hindrance to his vision of a [[Sith Empire (Exar Kun)/Legends|new]] [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]], Kun traveled to Empress Teta and touched down in the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] capital city. Guided by [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to their location, Kun stormed the Iron Citadel and confronted Qel-Droma.

What followed was a brief but heated duel, with neither combatant able to best the other. As they battled, however, the amulets in each man's possession reacted to one another and began to resonate with dark side energies. The energies in turn summoned the spirit of an ancient Dark [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] named [[Marka Ragnos]], who ended the duel and, after a brief proclamation, bestowed upon Kun the title of Dark Lord of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] and named Qel-Droma his foremost [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]].

==Prelude==
{{Quote|So much for her. When she awakes, her power and her planet will be destroyed. And as for you&hellip;''"<br />"''You will not find me such easy prey!''"<br />"''Ahh, yes. Freedon Nadd spoke of another Jedi. You are Ulic Qel-Droma&hellip;prepare to die!|Exar Kun and Ulic Qel-Droma|<ref name="DLOTSA" />}}
[[File:ExarBlastsAleema.jpg|thumb|left|290px|Exar Kun incapacitates Aleema Keto.]]
In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3997 BBY]], the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]] arrived on the [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Empress Teta/Legends|Empress Teta]], after acquiring tremendous [[Sith sorcery/Legends|Sith powers]] under his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprenticeship]] with the ancient [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord]] [[Freedon Nadd]]. Kun believed that he had learned all that he could from the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] and used his newfound [[Force power/Legends|powers]] to destroy the [[Force ghost/Legends|spirit]] of Freedon Nadd, submitting him to [[Death/Legends|death]] for a second and final [[Time/Legends|time]]. Moments before his demise, Nadd contacted [[Satal Keto/Legends|Satal]] and [[Aleema Keto]], leaders of the [[Krath/Legends|Krath]] [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] [[Sith cult/Legends|cult]], whom he had also [[Sith training|initiated]] in the ways of [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] magic. Nadd alerted them of Kun's treachery and declared him to be a pretender to the Sith legacy. Nadd stated that the future of the Sith was in the hands of the Krath, and the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Ulic Qel-Droma/Legends|Ulic Qel-Droma]], whom the Ketos had [[Prison/Legends|imprisoned]] and [[Torture/Legends|tortured]] under suspicion of being a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]]. Nadd's spirit then departed, leaving the Ketos to contemplate the meaning of his words.<ref name="DLOTSA" /> Kun was aware of Nadd's other apprentices and saw them as threats to his plan of creating a [[Sith Empire (Exar Kun)/Legends|new]] [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]]. With plans to eliminate them, Kun traveled to Empress Teta in search of Nadd's other [[Sith acolyte/Legends|Sith acolytes]], just as the Jedi attacked the Tetan [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Cinnagar/Legends|Cinnagar]] in an attempt to rescue Qel-Droma.<ref name="DLotS6" />

The Jedi, led by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Nomi Sunrider]], failed in their [[Mission to Empress Teta|extraction mission]] to save Qel-Droma and left him with Aleema Keto within their palace, the [[Iron Citadel/Legends|Iron Citadel]]. After he [[Duel in the Iron Citadel (Satal Keto)|killed]] Satal in a fit of revenge for a previous [[Battle of Deneba|attack]] on [[Deneba/Legends|Deneba]], Qel-Droma was taken by Aleema as her partner in leadership of the Krath. Qel-Droma confessed to her his plan of wanting to infiltrate and destroy her Krath cult, to which she intimated that she was already aware. Aleema then gave Qel-Droma a [[Sith talisman/Legends|Sith amulet]] that had previously belonged to Satal. Unbeknownst to them both, Kun had recently arrived on Empress Teta with his [[Massassi/Legends|Massassi]] warriors in search of Nadd's other students. When his own amulet began to resonate with the power of the dark side, Kun knew that he had indeed located his adversaries. He was led by [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to the Iron Citadel, where he caught both Qel-Droma and Keto unawares, the latter of whom he quickly incapacitated with a [[Force blast|blast]] of Force energy. With the [[Gender/Legends|woman]] out of the way, Kun and Qel-Droma drew their [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] and engaged in [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]].<ref name="DLotS6" />

==The duel==
[[File:ExarVsUlic.jpg|280px|thumb|The Sith amulets attract as Kun and Qel-Droma duel.]]
{{Quote|You are skilled with a lightsaber&hellip;yet even my Master could not defeat me! I am the greatest swordsman in the galaxy!''"<br />"''Come. Let us see!|Exar Kun and Ulic Qel-Droma, as they duel|audio=UlicVsKun.flac|<ref name="DLOTSA" />}}
The ensuing [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|duel]] was short-lived, and for much of it Kun and Qel-Droma remained evenly matched, with neither man able to gain an advantage over the other. Unexpectedly, however, the Sith amulets that the two men wore began to interact with each other. What they did not know was that the amulets had once been a pair, separated from each other many thousands of generations ago. The sudden and unexpected reunion stirred the spirit of the long dead Dark [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] of the Sith [[Marka Ragnos]].<ref name="DLotS6" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|In my time, even as the Galactic Republic battles us to extinction, we now secure the future, when the Sith will take their revenge!|Marka Ragnos, to Ulic Qel-Droma and Exar Kun|<ref name="DLotS6" />}}
[[File:UlicExarUnited.jpg|thumb|left|230px|The Sith Brotherhood is born.]]
The ancient Dark Lord immediately put an end to the duel and explained to them that his appearance was the result of the reunion of the amulets. Ragnos sensed that both had chosen the path of the dark side and knew that the two before him were capable of restoring<ref name="DLotS6" /> the Sith to the [[Golden Age of the Sith|Golden Age]] they had enjoyed while under Ragnos's rule.<ref name="GAOTS2">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith 2|''Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith'' 2]]</ref> He seized Kun and marked his forehead with the [[Mark of Dark Lord of the Sith|symbol]] of the Dark Lords and proclaimed him the new Dark Lord of the Sith. Ragnos [[Mark of Shadow Hand|tattooed]] Qel-Droma's forehead as well and named him as Kun's foremost apprentice. Ragnos then stated that through Kun and Qel-Droma, the foundations would be laid that would one day allow the Sith to exact their revenge on the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi]]. Bound by destiny and united by [[Dark Lord prophecy|prophecy]], Kun and Qel-Droma joined forces as [[Sith Master/Legends|Sith Master]] and apprentice, respectively.<ref name="DLotS6" /> Together with Keto's Krath, the trio later [[Great Sith War/Legends|terrorized]] the Republic in the form of the [[Brotherhood of the Sith]].<ref name="TSW">''[[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War]]''</ref>

Kun and his Brotherhood were eventually defeated,<ref name="TSW6">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War 6|''Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War'' 6]]</ref> but a new Sith threat emerged more than [[3681 BBY|300 years]] later, when the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|remnants]] of the Sith Empire that had been [[Second battle of Korriban|defeated]] and [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exiled]] in the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]] of [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]] returned to besiege the Republic in yet [[Great Galactic War|another struggle]] for total [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] domination. The Jedi were unaware of the existence of the previously unrealized threat, and the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|High Council]] charged [[Kel Dor/Legends|Kel Dor]] [[Jedi archivist/Legends|Jedi archivist]] [[Gnost-Dural]] with the task of discovering the origins of the revitalized Sith Empire.<ref name="Act1">''[[The Old Republic, Threat of Peace Act 1: Treaty of Coruscant]]''</ref> In his research, Gnost-Dural recounted the struggle between Kun and Qel-Droma, and its significance with relation to the return of the Sith. Upon the completion of his account, the Kel-Dor Master expressed his belief that the Sith spirits who supported Kun's ascension to Dark Lord perhaps did not agree with the machinations of the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]] whose forces had besieged the galaxy in Gnost-Dural's time.<ref name="Timeline10">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Timeline 10: The Exar Kun War|int=Timeline 10: The Exar Kun War}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Second Duel in the Iron Citadel first appeared in the issue [[Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith 6|''Dark Lords of the Sith 6: Jedi Assault'']] of the [[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi (comic series)|''Tales of the Jedi'']] series of [[Star Wars comic books|comics]]. The duel was conceived and written by authors [[Tom Veitch]] and [[Kevin J. Anderson]], and was drawn by artist [[Art Wetherell]]. Veitch and Anderson used this pivotal duel to mark the alliance between the two fallen Jedi, Ulic Qel-Droma and Exar Kun, having both characters fulfill Marka Ragnos's prophecy and become Sith Lords. Following the [[1995]] release of the [[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith|''Dark Lords of the Sith'']] story arc, the Second Duel in the Iron Citadel also appeared in the [[Tales of the Jedi: Dark Lords of the Sith (audio drama)|''Tales of the Jedi: Dark Lords of the Sith'' audio drama]]. [[John Cygan]] voiced Ulic Qel-Droma, while Exar Kun was portrayed by voice actor [[Peter Renaday|Peter Reneday]].

[[File:Krath_vs_Massassi.jpg|250px|thumb|''Timeline 10'' incorrectly depicts Exar Kun and Ulic Qel-Droma's duel as having occurred outside of the Iron Citadel in the midst of an all-out battle.]]
In [[October]] of [[2010]], the Second Duel in the Iron Citadel was featured in [[Timeline 10: The Exar Kun War|''The Exar Kun War'']], the tenth installment of [[in-universe]] videos that provide backstory information for the upcoming ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' [[Star Wars video games|video game]] by [[BioWare]]. The video depicts the transpiration of events somewhat differently than what is shown in ''Jedi Assault''. It recounts Kun's arrival in Cinnagar as an invasion complete with a [[Legion/Legends|legion]] of Massassi warriors in tow,<ref name="Timeline10" /> while both ''Jedi Assault'' and the audio drama clearly illustrate an infiltration mission undertaken by Kun and his accompaniment of only two Massassi.<ref name="DLotS5" /><ref name="DLOTSA" /> The timeline video also shows Kun and Qel-Droma dueling one another outside of the Iron Citadel, both with the support of their [[Army/Legends|armies]],<ref name="Timeline10" /> while the duel actually takes place within the palace confines in ''Jedi Assault''. Also in the comic and audio adaptation, Kun becomes a Sith Lord only after the duel ends,<ref name="DLotS5" /><ref name="DLOTSA" /> but ''Timeline 10'' states that Kun had already achieved said rank after he earlier defeated the [[Sith wyrm]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]].<ref name="Timeline10" />

In ''Jedi Assault'', Qel-Droma's attire consists of nothing more than [[Color/Legends|yellow]] [[Boot/Legends|boots]], brown trousers, and an uncovered upper body exposing his wounded torso,<ref name="DLotS5" /> while ''Timeline 10'' erroneously depicts him in the [[Armor/Legends|armor]] he donned only after he partnered himself with Kun and returned to the [[Empress Teta system/Legends|Empress Teta system]],<ref name="Timeline10" /> which appeared in [[Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War 1|''Edge of the Whirlwind'']], the first issue in the ''[[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War]]'' story arc.<ref name="TSW1">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War 1|''Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War'' 1]]</ref> [[Robert Chestney]], one of the game developers for BioWare's ''The Old Republic'' video game, attributed the conflicting details to the accounts of an ill-informed Jedi Master who lived more than 300 years afterward.<ref name="TimelineRecon">{{TORweb|url=community/showthread.php?p=3109520#edit3109520|text=The Jedi Civil War - Page 10}}</ref>
